video_title: Draymond Green Reflects on Knicks Takes, Jalen Brunson Versus Steph Curry & NBA Foul-Baiting

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green apologizes for his 15 years of misery Knicks prediction
quotes.excerpt: I apologize for this one because I said 15 years of misery.
quotes.quote: I would like to apologize for this one. And I apologize for this one because I said 15 years of misery. And the reality is you all fired your coaching, you brought in a coach that won a championship with us, which was great and the right idea, and you all went and got more players like Mikal Bridges, like Carl-Anthony Towns. Yeah. I apologize for that one.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green doubts the Knicks are championship contenders
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they have what it takes to win at the highest level.
quotes.quote: Personally, the Knicks, I just don't believe that they're contenders. I don't think they have what it takes to win at the highest level. I think you can stifle their offense and make it hard on them anytime you have a couple guys on the floor at the same time that's really key guys and don't really want to defend. It makes it tough to win at the highest level. And so that's kind of my question with the Knicks. I double down on this. My question with the Knicks, if you have guys that don't defend, it's going to be hard. They are missing that one piece that makes you a championship team, and that's Kevin Durant, that's Steph Curry, that's SGA, that's LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green explains the importance of analytical expected scores
quotes.excerpt: Analytics play a huge role in what you see your NBA team do.
quotes.quote: Kenny said analytically we won two or three games on the expected score. Well, I don't make much of it because I know what analytics is. There's an analytical department that every NBA team has right now, and they run all these analytics all year from how many times I tie my shoe during the game to how many jump shots, to where the jump shots are, everything down to a T. One thing that they also do is every game the coaches get an expected score of the game based on all these different facts. All these different things that they take into account and they come out with an expected score. For all of you out there that don't know what Kenny is talking about, analytics play a huge role in what you see your NBA team do.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green dismisses the impact of flopping in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Guys that flop don't win. If you just got floppers out there they don't win.
quotes.quote: It's a big issue as you all make it out to be. I don't really care. As a defender, I've played against guys that flop. Guys that flop don't win. If you just got floppers out there they don't win. It just really doesn't happen. So you all can stop calling Shai Gilgeous-Alexander a flopper because he's a champion. And I can tell you, floppers don't really win, it just really doesn't happen.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green names his top three defensive teammates of all time
quotes.excerpt: Andrew Bogut number one, Clay Thompson number two, and I'd say number three, Andre Iguodala.
quotes.quote: Who are your top three defensive teammates of all time? Andrew Bogut number one, Clay Thompson number two. Clay Thompson, ball hawk. And I'd say number three, number three, my favorite defensive teammate of all time, or not favorite, but top three. Kevin Durant was elite defensively here. Elite. Andre Iguodala. Andre Iguodala made the game really easy. Got to go with Andre. It has to be Andre.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green compares Jalen Brunson's clutch ability to Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: It's definitely up there on an elite level, but you must win a championship.
quotes.quote: How does Jalen Brunson playoff late game clutch ability compare to Steph Curry? It's up there. It's definitely up there on an elite level, but you must win a championship to put it in the same category. Needless to say, Jalen Brunson, when Jalen Brunson got the game late and you on Jalen Brunson side, damn it you feel good about it. Like Steph Curry, but you can't compare it totally until Jalen Brunson is a champion.
